description: We are a multidisciplinary team with skills in software development, AI, machine learning, graphic design, and international business. At NASA Space Apps 2026, we're exploring how open planetary data can power an intuitive Martian map for safer exploration and mission planning. We value creativity, collaboration, and practical innovation, and welcome teammates interested in planetary science, geospatial data, GIS, and 3D visualization.
summary: One More Stop is an educational Marswalk simulator set in Jezero Crater. Explore real 3D terrain, compare two simulated routes, and decide whether an extra science stop fits a 20-minute return reserve. The simulator explains how travel and observation time change the margins on each route. It uses Mars observations to put a field decision in context and helps players practice weighing the value of a science stop against the time they need to get back.
details:
At Enchanted Lake in Jezero Crater, can you make one more science observation and return to base with your planned reserve intact? Follow a simulated Marswalk across a 3D terrain model. At the decision point, compare the time left at base after returning directly or making one extra stop.

The minimum reserve is 20 minutes. Route A leaves 35 minutes on a direct return and 15 minutes after the extra stop. Route B leaves 25 and 5 minutes, respectively. The player makes the decision. The routes, timings, and reserve are assumptions for this educational simulation.

HiRISE stereo elevations shape the 400 × 400 m terrain. THEMIS adds a relative nighttime infrared layer at 100 m per pixel. A Perseverance Hazcam photo and a historical MEDA pressure reading give scientific context. The terrain surface material is illustrative. The app is built with React, TypeScript, Vite, and React Three Fiber. Independent QA exercised all four route and return combinations in Chrome.

Quick start: Select Ruta A or Ruta B and choose Iniciar simulación to start. At the decision, choose Regreso directo to return directly or Parada extra to make the additional science stop.

AI disclosure: OpenAI Codex and GPT-6.1 models assisted with specification, coordination, QA, and preparation of the submission. A Gemini coding agent assisted with implementation. The demo uses AI-generated English narration from HeyGen Voice (Annie – Lifelike), credited on screen and in the video metadata. The simulator calculates outcomes with fixed scenario rules and uses observed NASA data for terrain and context.
